mapper.select: select bc.id, bc.chapter_name as chapterName from book_chapter as bc where book_id = #{bookId} and bc.chapter_status = 1 order by chapter_num asc

select bc.id, bc.book_id as bookId, bc.chapter_num as chapterNum, bc.chapter_name as chapterName, bc.chapter_content as chapterContent from book_chapter as bc where bc.id = #{chapterId} and bc.book_id = #{bookId} and bc.chapter_status = 1
select id from book_chapter where book_id = #{bookId} and chapter_num < #{chapterNum} and chapter_status = 1 order by chapter_num desc limit 1
select bc.id from book_chapter as bc where bc.book_id = #{bookId} and bc.chapter_num > #{chapterNum} and chapter_status = 1 order by bc.chapter_num limit 1
